title: 28nm macro-channel congestion at first detailed route after clean post-CTS
design_context: 28nm, ~1.05M placeable instances, 82 hard macros (SRAM), 3 clocks 400MHz/200MHz/100MHz, commercial P&R
prior_state: Util 74%, post-CTS WNS -38ps TNS -0.6ns, GR overflow 0.6% pre-route, 0 DRC, 6% of bins >85% density
observation: First detailed route stalled 94% complete, 2100 opens, GR overflow 4.1% concentrated 92% in two vertical macro channels width 35um between SRAM columns, peak overflow 18% in M3/M4, pin density 580 per 100um in channel, severity: HIGH
hypothesis: SRAM pin arrays facing channel plus M3/M4 PG straps aligned over channel created systematic M2/M3 access blockage, not uniform over-utilization.

candidates_considered.action: Expand floorplan 4% to reduce utilization to 68%
candidates_considered.rejected_because: Requires top-level re-integration and bump re-spin, 10-day schedule hit and area cost ~0.8mm2, invalidates pinout.

candidates_considered.action: Rotate 50% of SRAMs 90deg to spread pins
candidates_considered.rejected_because: Requires full CTS rebuild, risk of timing regression >100ps on 400MHz domain and IR drop +12mV, needs Liberty re-char.

candidates_considered.action: Insert hard placement blockage 8um in channels to force spreading
candidates_considered.rejected_because: Pushes cells to already dense periphery, worsens WNS by 60ps and still leaves pin access issue, area penalty.

candidates_considered.action: Apply non-default rule doubling M2 pitch in channel
candidates_considered.rejected_because: Reduces available tracks further, trial run increased overflow to 3.1% and added 15% runtime.

chosen_intervention: Kept floorplan, added 3um soft halo around macro pins in channels, swapped 16% of cells in channels from 9T to 12T low-pin-density variant, created route guide forcing 60% block on M2/M3 in first 1.5um above SRAM pins and promoting escape to M4, re-ran detailed route with 2-pass search honoring halo.
post_state: GR overflow 0.22% peak 2.4%, detailed route 100% with 38 DRCs cleaned in 2nd pass, effective utilization 73.2%, WNS -72ps TNS -1.0ns, cost 34ps from spreading but acceptable
expert_assessment: Right call for 28nm channel congestion - halo plus cell variant swap attacks pin-access root without floorplan churn. General lesson: check overflow concentration and pin density before assuming global congestion. Would not transfer if congestion were due to high-fanout signal trunk or power-mesh blockage.
weakest_point: The 3um halo width is an estimate that must be calibrated to the foundry pin-access DRC deck for this SRAM type.

title: Many small shared-startpoint failures vs few large distributed failures
design_context: 28nm, 620k placeable instances, 10 macros, 1 clock 500MHz 2ns period, commercial synthesis and P&R
prior_state: Util 67%, GR overflow 0.3%, WNS -380ps TNS -16ns, 11200 failing endpoints at post-route STA, no DRCs
observation: Slack histogram 10400 endpoints -5ps to -70ps all from same input bus data_in[31:0], 2 logic levels to first flop, 87% share same input delay and clock uncertainty, 3 outliers -350ps to -380ps with 28 logic stages deep, severity: MODERATE
hypothesis: Two distinct signatures: bulk small shared-startpoint failures indicates input constraint over-constrain, while 3 large outliers indicate true logic depth and placement distance problem needing separate fix.

candidates_considered.action: Upsize entire failing logic cone and add 120ps useful skew
candidates_considered.rejected_because: Adds 11% area and 15mW leakage for 10k paths that are constraint-driven, increases IR 9mV in input cluster with no benefit.

candidates_considered.action: Re-place input flops 2um closer to pads
candidates_considered.rejected_because: Requires IO re-spin, 2-day schedule cost, does not fix 1.2ns input delay that is still 0.6x period and unrealistic.

candidates_considered.action: Pipeline after inputs adding flop stage
candidates_considered.rejected_because: Changes latency 1 cycle, requires RTL change and full re-verification, not allowed in ECO window.
Hides real margin, risks hold and top-level failures, violates signoff methodology.

chosen_intervention: Split fix by signature: for bulk, corrected set_input_delay from 1.2ns to 0.58ns per board spec and added set_input_transition 100ps, re-ran STA; for 3 outliers, did targeted placement pull 15um closer and upsized 8 cells on 28-stage paths, then re-routed those nets.
post_state: Bulk 0 failures after constraint fix, outliers WNS -22ps TNS -0.08ns after placement fix, total failing 92 endpoints remaining, utilization unchanged, no area growth
expert_assessment: Correct triage by report shape before touching netlist. Lesson: count sharing and histogram shape distinguishes constraint vs physical vs logic depth. Would not transfer if failures were evenly spread across clock domains with varied slack and no common startpoint.
weakest_point: The corrected 0.58ns input delay is plausible but would need confirmation from board-level SI report.

title: Output budget split between crypto core and interconnect fabric
design_context: 16nm, block A 1.0M instances 42 macros, block B 0.85M instances 18 macros, interface 128-bit at 800MHz 1.25ns, commercial P&R and STA
prior_state: Top budget 1.25ns, initial 50/50: 0.625ns A clk-to-out and 0.625ns B in-to-reg, A WNS -95ps TNS -0.9ns, B WNS +210ps
observation: A output paths failing 70-95ps, 6 stages XOR tree before output, B has large positive slack 180-210ps on same interface, no congestion, severity: MODERATE
hypothesis: 50/50 split over-constrains block A which has deeper pre-output logic; budget should weight by logic depth 65/35 to avoid unnecessary upsizing in A while preserving margin in B.

candidates_considered.action: Keep 50/50 and upsize A output logic
candidates_considered.rejected_because: Costs 3.5% area and 20mW power, creates IR hotspot near pins, marginal timing benefit only.

candidates_considered.action: Move to 35/65 giving more to B (0.35ns A, 0.65ns B)
candidates_considered.rejected_because: Makes A WNS -180ps requiring floorplan change, no benefit as B already has slack, wastes power.

candidates_considered.action: False path interface and close at top level
candidates_considered.rejected_because: Hides real timing, risk silicon failure at 800MHz, violates signoff methodology and would be caught in top STA.

chosen_intervention: Allocated by FO4 depth: avg 12 FO4 in A after last flop vs 5 in B before first flop, set 0.78ns to A and 0.47ns to B, encoded as set_output_delay 0.47ns on A and set_input_delay 0.78ns on B with 50ps uncertainty, documented in SDC header with depth calculation.
post_state: A WNS +12ps TNS +0.01ns, B WNS +48ps, top-level interface slack +18ps, no area change, no extra power
expert_assessment: Right trade - budget follows depth not arbitrary half. General lesson: derive budgets from measured stage count and document rejected splits. Would not transfer if interface had CDC or multicycle where exception not budget is appropriate.
weakest_point: FO4 depth counts 12 vs 5 are illustrative and would need real path-length extraction from STA in practice.
